evidence: Adds rebroadcastwallettx RPC and GUI action, touching src/wallet/wallet.cpp, src/wallet/rpc/transactions.cpp, and wallet interfaces.
rationale: Provides a direct way to rebroadcast unconfirmed wallet transactions from RPC and GUI, addressing a known user pain point. As noted in the PR description, 'there needs to be a way for users to rebroadcast a transaction' rather than manually extracting raw transaction hex and invoking `sendrawtransaction`.
